evidence_snippets: Use the gcloud CLI to read the events from Pub/Sub. gcloud pubsub subscriptions pull PUBSUB SUBSCRIPTION --auto-ack Forward messages from Pub/Sub to Kafka This section describes how to start the source connector, publish messages to Pub/Sub, and read the forwarded messages from Kafka.

Example: offset.storage.file.filename = /tmp/connect.offsets Forward events from Kafka to Pub/Sub This section describes how to start the sink connector, publish events to Kafka, and then read the forwarded messages from Pub/Sub.
For integer, float, string, and bytes schemas, the connector passes the bytes of the Kafka record value directly into the Pub/Sub message body.
